svg.aria-label: wireframe schematic — the app’s own layout, drawn frame by frame: the given, then each beat. given a beat whose harvest recorded the focus box its assertion ringed; beat 1: its row renders → the schematic cell and the proof cell are aimed by ONE camera at the same region of the same page, so the drawing and the photograph can never frame different things; beat 2: you read the words that caption them → both sides carry that beat and no other — the drawing derived from and labelled with its When → Then, the row's text cell showing the same sentence — while the Given row stays whole-page and uncaptioned on both sides
